subject: Mutual Action Plan & Ownership Matrix — Transition Blueprint for Solstice Health
messages: Subject: Draft MAP: ownership matrix + proposed milestones (Solstice)

Good morning and thanks again for the time today. As discussed, attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (Solstice-MAP-v1.xlsx) that outlines milestones, owners, and suggested target dates for the onboarding and go-live window. High level:
- Week 1–3: Private deployment prep (network, KMS, access), data ingestion smoke tests
- Week 4–6: Model tuning, evals, and performance validation
- Week 7: Pilot traffic ramp and canary monitoring

Can you confirm the procurement contact and any hard blackout dates for October/November? If the above looks reasonable, I’ll loop in our CS lead and Solutions PM to convert this into a living schedule and SOW draft for your legal/procurement teams.
Subject: Re: Draft MAP: ownership matrix + proposed milestones (Solstice)
Thanks for sending this over and for the call. The timeline looks aligned with our internal expectations, though we do have two constraints:
1) Our security review team is out the week of Oct 18 (holiday), so any infra handoffs ideally happen before Oct 15 or after Oct 25
2) Procurement needs an SOW and a redlines tracker by EOD next Monday to hit our October legal window

I’ve cc’d Braden (Procurement) to own the contract steps. Please add a column in the MAP for ‘procurement milestones’ and include a SOW placeholder. Also can you put expected acceptance criteria for the pilot (latency & error budget) in the validation row? Those specifics will speed review on our side.

Subject: Fwd: Draft MAP: ownership matrix + proposed milestones (Solstice) — please review & assign owners

Forwarding Solstice’s comments (below). Braden is their procurement lead; Elena asked for procurement milestones and explicit pilot acceptance criteria. Can each of you take a pass on the attached SOW-draft and the MAP spreadsheet and provide:
- Any constraints on dates (we should avoid the Oct 18–25 security blackout window Elena called out),
- Proposed acceptance criteria (latency P50/P95, error budget, throughput) for the validation rows
- A short risk note (one line) per milestone if you foresee blockers

I’ve put a preliminary owner column in the sheet but it’s intentionally loose — want your concrete callouts so we can send a cleaned MAP back to Solstice today. Attaching SOW-draft-v2.pdf for legal review context.
Subject: Re: Fwd: Draft MAP: ownership matrix + proposed milestones (Solstice) — please review & assign owners

Quick pass below with owners, dates, acceptance criteria and a couple of callouts. I edited the MAP spreadsheet directly (drive link below) and added a ‘status’ column so Solstice can track gating items.
- Kickoff call: owner: Karthik; target: 2027-10-13; acceptance: agenda + attendee list
- Contract execution / SOW sign: owner: Braden (Solstice) & Karthik; target: 2027-10-15; acceptance: countersigned SOW
- Network & KMS validation: owner: Monica; window: 2027-10-16 to 2027-10-22 (avoid 10/18–10/25 intensive review); acceptance: successful test key exchange & secure subnet routing
- Data ingest smoke test: owner: Marissa; window: 2027-10-18 to 2027-10-21; acceptance: sample 10k rows imported, schema match, no PII leakage alerts
- Model tuning & evals: owner: Soojin; window: 2027-10-20 to 2027-11-03; acceptance: eval suite pass rate >= 92% on quality checks
- Pilot ramp & observability: owner: Marissa; window: 2027-11-04 to 2027-11-10; acceptance: P50 latency < 80ms, P95 < 250ms, error rate < 0.5%
- Go-live: owner: Karthik & Marissa; target: 2027-11-15; acceptance: traffic shift to production, SLOs met for 48h
- Security review blackout: procurement/security outage 2027-10-18 — we should avoid infra handoffs then
- Data access approvals: Solstice needs an internal DPA sign-off before we ingest production data; may slide the data ingest window by 3–5 business days
- Pilot acceptance criteria above are aggressive — recommend a short two-day remediation plan if metrics miss by <10%
I’ll sync with Monica tomorrow AM on network prerequisites. If everyone agrees I’ll produce a one-page MAP summary for Solstice to sign off on and attach the SOW for procurement.
Cc: Braden Cho <braden.cho@solsticehealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.inference>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.inference>
Subject: Agreed MAP & next steps — Solstice Health

Thanks for the quick turnaround and for confirming constraints. Per Marissa’s pass above I’ve attached the one-page MAP and the SOW draft for your procurement/legal review. Key next steps we all agreed on:
1) Kickoff call: 2027-10-13 — Karthik will host and share agenda
2) Procurement submission: Braden to review SOW and provide redlines by 2027-10-15
3) Network & KMS prep: Monica to validate access between 10/16–10/22
4) Data ingest smoke: Marissa to run 10/18–10/21 (contingent on DPA sign-off)
5) Pilot & validation: Soojin to lead model evals 10/20–11/03
6) Go-live target: 2027-11-15 (subject to procurement & security approvals)
Drive link with the updated MAP and acceptance criteria: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cSolstice-Shared-MAP

If that schedule works I’ll create the mutual-action signature page and send a single consolidated packet to Braden for countersignature. Open to any edits — want to lock dates by EOD Friday so procurement can make the October window.
